turns.text: Practice
The board is empty and I have 24 different pieces available. Could you please tell me which piece to place first and where to put it?
Top left corner, a circle with a faint pink background and a concentric circle
I placed the piece with a faint pink background and a concentric circle (ID 5) in the top left corner at position (0, 0). Please let me know the next placement!
No, it has a circle that is not connected to itself

Thank you for the clarification. I'll remove the current piece from the top left. Could you confirm if you want piece ID 13 (the one with a single unconnected circle on a pale background) to go at (0, 0)?
Yes please
I placed piece ID 13 (with the pale background and single unconnected circle) in the top left corner at (0, 0). What should I do next?
Please remove that
I have removed the piece from the top left corner. Please let me know which piece should go in (0, 0) instead.
It is paint pink background with a swirl pattern that goes around in a circle type pattern
I placed piece ID 6 (pale pink background with a swirl pattern that goes around in a circle) in the top left corner at (0, 0). Please let me know what to do next!
That is correct.
Great! The top left corner (0, 0) now has the correct piece (pale pink with a swirl, ID 6). Please let me know which piece should go next and where to place it.
Directly to the right of that is a pale backround with a pattern of diamonds joined together with 3 in a row across then 2 across and there are 5 of these going down

I placed piece ID 11 (pale background with a pattern of joined diamonds, arranged 3 in a row across, 2 across below, and five rows down) directly to the right of the top left corner at (1, 0). Please let me know if this is correct or what to do next!
Underneath the top left there is a pink background with 5 lines, left to right, the lines go down at the start of the line and then up towards the end and down again at the end of the lone

I placed piece ID 9 (pink background with 5 lines, each going down, then up, then down again across the tile) directly underneath the top left at position (0, 1). Is this correct? What is the next piece and placement?
Pink background with lines horizontally, starting at the right the lines go down, then up, then down again. There are 5 from top to botton

I placed piece ID 2 (pink background with five horizontal lines that go down, then up, then down again across the tile) directly underneath the last piece at position (0, 2). Let me know if this is correct and what to place next!
The last two are incorrect, please remove them
I've removed the last two pieces from (0, 1) and (0, 2). Please let me know your next instructions for these positions!
Please also remove the bottom piece

There are currently only two pieces on the board, at positions (0, 0) and (1, 0). There are no pieces below them. Please let me know if you'd like to place a new piece, and if so, which one and where!
please remove the last piece that was placed
I have removed the last piece placed at (1, 0). Please let me know which piece should go there instead!
Please put back 0,1
I placed piece ID 9 (pink background with vertical wavy lines) back at position (0, 1) as requested. Let me know what to do next!
No remove that
I have removed the piece at (0, 1). The only piece now on the board is the top left corner (ID 6, pink swirl). Please let me know what to do next!
